description: A fixed-height scrolling panel has no focusable content, so keyboard users cannot scroll it.

issue.help: Scrollable region must have keyboard access
issue.html:
Added watering reminders to every plant page.

Fixed a bug that reset your wishlist on sign-out.

Delivery estimates now include public holidays.

Plant care guides load faster on slow connections.
issue.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element should have focusable content
  Element should be focusable
